name: Contract Test Trigger and Retrieve
description: Validates the contract test pipeline: a run is triggered for the seti application (fire-and-forget, returns 'accepted' immediately), and historical results are retrievable from the Results Job. The trigger is asynchronous by design — the run executes in the background and results are polled.
author: claude-sonnet-4-6-session-20260410

steps.description: Health check — contract-test confirms Redis connectivity and scheduler status
Trigger a contract test run — returns 'accepted' immediately, run executes asynchronously
Verify historical contract results are stored and retrievable from the Results Job
